result.quote: I wholly dedicate the silver to the LORD for my son’s benefit, to make a graven image and a molten idol.
result.reason: The key is supported as a broad paraphrase of making the graven image and molten idol. However, “For what” is ambiguous because the same verse also says the silver is dedicated “for my son’s benefit”; thus that is another defensible answer. Ask instead, “What does Micah’s mother intend the dedicated silver to be used to make?”
